notes.title: Bug Bounty!
notes.content:
Howdy all you GLOBAL ELITES!

Among a variety of small bug fixes, I've added a Bug Bounty rewarded for every mission you play. For every 20 bugs you kill, you get $1 (in-game currency). This will allow you to buy upgrades and progress more quickly. I'm also hoping it makes death a less punishing affair.

Thank you so much for being here for GLOBAL ELITE's launch. As my first game on Steam, this has been a huge learning experience, and this should be the first of many updates to come.

If you've had any crashes or come across anything that seems like an unintentional bug, please let me know. If there's anything you'd like to see in the game, or even something you hate about it, please let me know. The feedback I've gotten so far has been amazing, and I'm looking forward to hearing more from you!

[url=https://forms.gle/kU5koNndquGzt2Qh8]Feedback form[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/MeGTgN4mAy]Discord[/url]

Thanks again, and have a great day!
